environment.description: EKS pod running in subnet with NAT gateway egress. Service exposed via internal NLB on port 8080. IAM role attached to pod has s3:GetObject, s3:PutObject, s3:ListBucket on Resource '*'. No VPC endpoint for S3 configured - traffic routes through NAT gateway to public S3 endpoints. WebSocket endpoint /ws/stream accessible from any pod in the cluster via ClusterIP service. No network policy restricting ingress to the pod.

config.network: ClusterIP service, no NetworkPolicy, NAT gateway egress
